text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"To everyone in the village, how are you 
doing? I'm doing totally, wonderfully 
great!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I have some very wonderful news to share 
today! The date for my debut in the 
Twinkle Series has been decided!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I'll give it every single ounce of 
strength I've got and bring good news back 
to everyone. Please watch over me kindly!"

"Starting tomorrow, the real training with 
Yukino Bijin for her Twinkle Series debut 
begins."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer, excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I've come to give my proper greetings!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
First off, thank ya kindly for formin' a 
contract with me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm still weak and unreliable, but... I'll 
see through everything you tell me to do!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin's gonna do her absolute best, 
yes she will!
choice_data_list: Let's do our best together from now on!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes! Looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
An' it ain't much, but I got a little gift 
for you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Mom and Dad gave me a whole bunch of 
Morioka specialties to bring with me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I recommend the sablés! They're nice and 
soft, and super tasty.

Yukino Bijin is an Umamusume from Morioka. 
While Tracen Academy has many girls from 
regional areas, one with such strong local 
flair is rare.
choice_data_list: Thanks for going out of your way.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Nope. Ma and Pa told me to make sure I 
send their best regards to ya!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in the village told me, "The 
whole village is behind you, so go give it 
your all!" and gave me a big push forward.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna live up to absolutely everything 
everyone expects of me, no matter what!

Even immense expectations aren't pressure 
to her. Rather, they seem to be her source 
of strength.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And then, I'm gonna make my own dream come 
true along with it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
My dream of becoming a sparkling "City 
Girl"...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Cool, pretty, and strong, just like Gold 
City-san...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
By fighting, they're becoming who they 
wanna be with their own strength.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If that happens, then we can turn this 
"hype" into genuine support... I know we 
can!

The meaning behind those words became 
clear immediately. Just as I stepped out 
of the academy to walk Yukino Bijin back 
to the dorms—

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Ah! It's Yukino-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaah~! So cute~!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wh-wh-what?!

In front of the school gate, a crowd of 
what looked like Yukino Bijin's fans had 
gathered. They were all wearing the same 
T-shirt, which read—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"The Yukino Bijin Fan Club"...!? A f-fan 
club!? For me!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ayaa, this really is somethin' else, 
goodness me...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaah, a dialect! So cute~~♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't that... amazing? Yukino Bijin 
hasn't even debuted yet, has she?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Look, she's that! One of those local 
circuit Umamusume that are all the rage 
these days!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap-san, Inari One-san... You know 
how our senpais from the regional circuits 
did amazingly well in their races?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"And don't you think Yukino Bijin-chan is 
getting a lot of attention, too? She looks 
great, after all."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—Um, everyone! Thank you so much for your 
support!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm finally going to make my debut! Please 
look forward to my race!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right! Yukino-chan runs in races too, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen it before, but... if 
Yukino-chan wants me to come, I just have 
to go!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wah, I'm mighty glad! I'll be waitin' for 
ya~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fans
text_block_list.text: So cute~♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wah... Getting treated like such an idol 
already, that looks tough~...

The mini boom surrounding Yukino Bijin... 
As of now, it's rooted in her character 
and visuals.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. "Cute", huh?

—It's not her running that's drawing 
attention. Naturally, Yukino Bijin must be 
feeling conflicted, but...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"—It's alright! Didn't I tell you? 'A boom 
is an opportunity'!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Bein' in the spotlight is a 
chance, and as long as I work hard and 
show 'em what I can really do in the 
meantime... right?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"Right?! I'm your best friend, so you can 
believe me, can't you?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Fufu. That's right, ain't it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Mifuyu-chan—my always-cool childhood 
friend. We grew up together all this time, 
and... she's my comrade chasing the same 
dream.)

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"I see, so that's how it is~. Yuki-chan, 
you're finally standing at the starting 
line of making your dream come true. Guess 
you really beat me to it, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"I have to give it my all too! Compete in 
the world figure skating championship and 
stand at the top! I have to make this 
dream come true!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Mifuyu-chan, you're so good at skating! 
You can definitely make your dream come 
true!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks! I've gotta start building up a 
track record from now on. The amazing kids 
my age have already been getting real 
results for a while."

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"Jumping's still always been my weak point 
too! I guess my goal from now on is to 
practice a ton and learn to clear them 
consistently."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Mifuyu-chan can definitely jump it! 
I mean, she's *the* Mifuyu-chan, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, which one? But... thank you. Let's 
both do our best towards our dreams!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone in the village, Trainer, and 
Mifuyu-chan... They're all cheering for 
me.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Besides, I've already got fans backing me 
up. I gotta get results while the hype's 
still going!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All right...! First up is the debut race. 
I'm gonna do my best!
